title: TopoSteer: Topological Layer Selection for Activation Steering in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.01493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time by adding a vector to their internal representations. Most work asks how to build that vector, and far less attention has gone to where to add it, even though steering at a poorly chosen layer can be worse than not steering at all. Prior selectors choose a layer without ever steering the model to test it: they score how separable the target behavior is at that layer, and how consistently the individual examples point along the steering direction. We argue that what matters is not the separability of the two activation clouds, nor the alignment of individual displacements with their mean, but the extent of the cloud of per-example displacements that mean-difference steering averages. translated_title: TopoSteer：面向大语言模型激活引导的拓扑学层选择方法
translated_abstract: 激活引导（activation steering）通过在推理时向大语言模型的内部表示中添加一个向量来对模型进行控制。现有研究大多关注如何构建这个向量，而对“应该把它加到哪一层”的关注却少得多——尽管在不当选择的层上进行引导，效果可能比不引导还要糟糕。以往的层选择器在选层时从不实际引导模型进行测试：它们只是评估目标行为在该层的可分离程度，以及各个样本沿引导方向的一致性。我们认为，真正重要的既不是两个激活分布云的可分离性，也不是各样本位移与其均值的对齐程度，而是均值差分引导所平均的“逐样本位移云”的延展范围。我们提出了一种基于拓扑的层选择方法，称为 TopoSteer，它通过位移云的总 H_0 持续度（persistence）来为各层打分，该持续度由位移云的欧几里得……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TopoSteer 提出了一种基于拓扑数据分析（H_0 持续度）的大语言模型激活引导层选择方法，通过度量逐样本位移云的延展范围来选出最有效的引导层，弥补了以往方法只看激活可分离性而不实际测试引导效果的不足。
en_tdlr: TopoSteer proposes a topology-based layer selection method for activation steering in LLMs, scoring layers by the total H_0 persistence of per-example displacement clouds to identify the most effective layer to apply steering.
